omniroute.serverUrl.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated. The bridge address now travels inside the pairing code you paste (it starts with `omr_link_`), and is stored securely rather than in settings. Run **OmniRoute: Connect (paste pairing code)** instead. If a value is set here it is only read once, to migrate an old setup, and then cleared.
omniroute.serverUrl.description: Deprecated — superseded by the pairing code.

omniroute.pairingToken.markdownDeprecationMessage: Deprecated for security. A pairing code placed here is synced across machines by Settings Sync and can be committed to a repo via `.vscode/settings.json`. It is now stored in the OS keychain instead. Any value found here is moved into secure storage and then removed automatically on the next launch. Use **OmniRoute: Connect (paste pairing code)**.
omniroute.pairingToken.description: Deprecated — pasted via the Connect command and stored securely.
